text:
neel: alert triggered: eu-west2 small-genpar p95 jumped 3x around 03:14 UTC. initial traces show lots of warmup workers hitting the same NAT pool. anyone seen this pattern before? :eyeglasses:

carmen: yup. recent fractional-warmers experiment enabled 'egress_fastpath' and i think all warmup workers picked the default natgw-4. NAT queue depth spiked.

tomo: NAT logs snippet:
```
03:13:56 natgw-4 queue_depth=10
03:14:02 natgw-4 queue_depth=96
03:14:08 natgw-4 queue_depth=187 dropped=5
03:14:20 natgw-4 conn_open_count=640
```

neel: that matches the p95 tail. options: throttle warmup egress, move warmup to separate nat pool, or add allocator-side preconditions. Short term what can we toggle quickly?

carmen: easiest: set slice annotation to `egress_route=throttled` which triggers the proxy to rate-limit egress traffic. I can flip it.

peter: thumbs up. do it and monitor NAT queue and p95. note side-effect: preemptible warmups will back up. we should update oncall runbook before toggling.

carmen: toggling now: `curl -XPOST https://allocator.svc/slices/eu-west2/warmers/annotate -d '{"egress_route":"throttled"}'` -> 202 Accepted.

infra-bot: metric: natgw-4 queue_depth reduced 187 -> 38 within 50s. small-genpar p95 reduced to ~170ms. Incident INF-2026-119 created.

neel: ok mitigation worked. let's avoid repeated flip-flops. proposal: allocator should require per-rack NAT headroom > 25% && tenant.kv_hit_rate > 60% before granting any egress_fastpath/burst. if not, mark slice `backfill-paused` and schedule exponential backoff.

tomo: also propose egress credits per-tenant. naive model: credits := min(1000, baseline) replenishes at 10/s. each open connection consumes 2 credits/sec. if credits < 100 -> no burst. credits can be increased gradually as kvcache warms.

carmen: i like credits + kvcache heuristic. plus add `egress_route` label so infra can route warmup to `natgw-warmup-pool` later. low-effort and gives us path to split traffic.

peter: two operational notes: (1) add allocator dry-run mode to simulate credits for 48h before flipping, (2) surface a metric `allocator.egress_credit.blocked_backfills` and an alert when >3/min so SRE sees when warmup is being rate-limited.

neel: agree. tomo can you prototype credit accounting and a dry-run job? aim for a demo tomorrow.

tomo: yes. landing branch: allocator/egress-credit-model. i'll add `--dry-run` flag that outputs a daily dashboard.

carmen: i'll update runbook: how to toggle `egress_route` + who to page if backlog grows. will post link shortly.

infra-bot: note: created ticket ALLOC-812 (egress credits + nat route label) and scheduled 48h sim job.

neel: long term: plan a separate autoscaled NAT fleet for warmup with separate egress IPs or move warmup outbound traffic to a different AZ NAT. big infra effort, file as RFE. short term: credits + preconditions + label should reduce noisy-neighbor surface.

peter: can we also add a guard in the allocator: if rack.egress_util > 85% then immediately set `backfill-paused` for any slices that request egress_fastpath. automatic recovery after util < 70% for 60s.

carmen: will add that rule to the prototype.

neel: great. thanks for the quick turn. marking incident resolved once dry-run shows expected behavior. reopen if tail climbs back.
